name: Wax
author: Erin Carter
description: A lava lamp without the lamp: a dark liquid pool clings to the bottom of the frame while two or three molten wax bodies pinch off it, rise through the column with a bright snap, stall, and reluctantly sink back to be reabsorbed.

params.label: Rise speed
params.effect: How fast the wax bodies climb, stall, and sink through their loops.

params.label: Blob size
params.effect: Radius of the rising wax bodies in css pixels.

params.label: Pool depth
params.effect: Fraction of the frame height filled by the basal pool.

params.label: Wobble
params.effect: Amplitude of the settling wobble that runs along the pool crest after each detach and rejoin; at zero the crest stays glassy calm.
